ciCommands.npm run lint:tests: Runs the repository guard that stops tests from reading the live source tree.
ciCommands.npm run build -w @vvedantb/redline && np: Builds the package first because the demo and landing apps type-check against its built output. The two share a line so the parallel runner keeps that order.
ciCommands.npm test -w @vvedantb/redline -- ${VV_TE: Runs Vitest on the tests the pull request can reach. The shared workflow leaves the variable empty for a full run, which then runs every test and fails on zero tests.
